project.name: Spring Roo Annotations (reconstructed stub)
project.description: Compile-time-only stub reconstructed from the annotation usages found in the CCFMaster sources. The genuine artifact is unobtainable in 2026. Roo's annotations are SOURCE-retention and are read only by the Roo tooling that generated the .aj ITDs, all of which are checked in, so this stub is sufficient to compile the original unchanged.
